mechanism: useSyncExternalStore observes the cache stable snapshots; immediate subscription replay is preserved. React Object.is suppresses identical warm updates.
coverage: A publication while B is active, then return to A
refresh states, retained error and retry
server request isolation with no cache mutation
suspended uncommitted render cannot replace loader
disabled state and stale visibility/focus refresh
limits: Real ReactDOM renders null using a minimal host document. It verifies hook rendering/effects, not native DOM layout or paint latency.
Per-hook render counts cannot be summed across hooks/providers because React may batch their updates.
Production performance still requires deployed browser acceptance.
